name: order-gated greedy acceptance
mechanism: reject a candidate before evaluating it unless it is strictly smaller under the order; adopt it only if the property holds and the transition is allowed, so the current best descends monotonically
fails_when: a local minimum under the move set is a fixed point
candidates simpler under a different order are rejected unseen
classified_by: Nyx 2026-09-12 from the organ record; classification is T3 until a query test exercises it
